## Thorn's Evening Drop

A personal 5:30 PM digest built from the choices already in your ThornixOS Glance page: Alsip weather, gameranx, Skill Up, GameLinked, Digital Foundry, r/pcgaming, and r/gamingnews.

It contains no SOC or infrastructure data, uses no AI service, and stores no feed HTML. Delivery supports **SMTP** and an encrypted **Discord Webhook** credential; select each credential on its delivery node, test once, then publish.
